reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis relies on forming Cu-rich nanolamellae in a Cu-free Cantor alloy via segregation during solidification, which is physically impossible without adding Cu; this fundamental flaw makes the mechanism unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, but it cannot truly falsify the hypothesis because the starting material cannot produce the required Cu-rich phase, making the experiment irrelevant.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a physically impossible premise (Cu segregation from a Cu-free alloy), so it would misdirect research effort.
